pr.title: Review Projector's own pull requests in GitHub Actions
pr.head: bcef50dcaf9e9642c541b25bf1d15d3697ba7bb0

summary: Projector currently reviews this repository’s pull requests from agent sessions. This layer enables the same review flow on GitHub-hosted runners, so ready pull requests with a branch in this repository can receive a review without a laptop session.

The workflow runs Claude through the shared review action and gives a separate job permission to publish the resulting review page. The committed settings identify the workflow’s bot as a trusted source of Projector verdicts. A runner-specific configuration replaces gate commands that cannot run on the hosted image while retaining the exact-head CI check.

cards.title: What remains after merge
cards.html:
• The action is called at @main, so the first complete hosted review needs the stack to land there.
  • Set exactly one Claude credential secret: CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. This review neither read nor changed either secret.
  • The first real run must still verify the hosted-runner facts listed in the CI review plan.

cards.title: Review evidence
cards.html:
• The configured gate and exact-head check workflow passed, including 256 hook tests.
  • Eighteen focused tests passed for CI setup, credential selection, and bot verdict readers.
  • A local configuration check confirmed the gate override wins without dropping the exact-head check requirement.
  • The published review is clean, with no findings or suggestions.

groups.title: Count the workflow’s reviews
groups.kicker: Enable CI review and recognize its bot
intro: A review posted by github-actions[bot] is not a human collaborator’s review. Public repositories ignore verdicts from untrusted accounts, so enabling the workflow also records that this bot’s Projector verdicts count.

The settings select Claude and enable later init refreshes. Once they reach the default branch, sessions, the panel, and the site can use the bot’s verdict in the same sign-off calculation as other trusted reviews.

files.note: Enable CI reviews with Claude and add the Actions bot to the counted reviewer list.

checks.text: Focused status, watch, and site tests confirm that the named bot’s verdict counts on a public repository while an unlisted account’s verdict does not.

groups.title: Run reviews with separate publication permissions
groups.kicker: Review ready branches and publish their summaries
intro: The review job runs for ready pull requests whose heads are in this repository and can also be started manually. It calls the action from main to preview unreleased Projector changes. Each new head cancels an older review for the same pull request and agent.

Each matrix entry names an agent and can name its model. This repository’s single Claude entry leaves the model empty, so the action supplies claude-opus-5-5. The updated workflow forwards the model field through to the action instead of leaving per-agent model choices behind.

The agent’s job can post reviews and statuses but cannot push code. A second job, which runs no agent, holds the write permission needed to publish summaries. The runner also refuses drafts and fork heads, so a manual trigger does not bypass that boundary.

The local review gate normally runs hook tests and a type-check that depends on declarations from an interactive Claude Code session. The workflow supplies a configuration override that runs plugin validation and the whitespace check on a hosted runner; the existing check workflow still supplies the suite and project checks.

files.note: Add the generated review workflow, forwarding per-agent models and preserving its runner-specific gate override.

checks.text: Traced the job condition and the runner’s own refusal: drafts and fork heads are excluded, including manual dispatch.

Executed this committed workflow’s resolved Claude inputs through the action’s review script against a command stub. It reached the command with model claude-opus-5-5, without starting an agent or using credentials.

Compared the whole file with the generated main/Claude workflow: only these five override lines differ. A local configuration check confirms the override wins and keeps review.gate_checks=check; the edited digest makes init preserve this workflow.
Exactly one of the two Claude secrets must be set. The action rejects both and neither; credential values were not read or changed during this review.
Traced the action’s two modes and the declared permissions: the review job lacks contents write, while only the summary job can push the page’s hidden ref.
